The note of /ledger/4 itself says the Imamate 'continued as an autonomous interior until the Jebel Akhdar War ended in 1959'. sultanate-of-oman /ledger/19 (1920-9 vassal_start), /ledger/21-22 (1954 vassal_end, contest_start), /ledger/25-26 (1959 contest_end, gain) all name imamate-of-oman, which has no mirror events because it ends in 1920.
fixes.fix: Extend the life to 1959 from the pages already opened: replace the 1920-9 dissolve with vassal_start (counterpart sultanate-of-oman, region the Cliopatria 1919 polygon, confidence 2); add 1954 vassal_end and contest_start (Jebel Akhdar War; the Treaty of Seeb page dates its start 25 October 1954), a 1955 loss of Nizwa if the Treaty of Seeb page supports it, and 1959 contest_end plus dissolve (counterpart sultanate-of-oman, mirror of its 1959 gain); a new keyframe imamate-of-oman_1920 (from 1920 to 1959, the 1919 polygon, verdict adjust); the Jebel Akhdar War in wars with its zone; certainty to 1959; successor land dated 1959; Ghalib al-Hinai 1954-1959 in rulers if wanted.
